name: example-corp-corpus
note: Synthetic corpus (data byte-identical to v2.0.0; renamed batch) for the Advanced RAG with OpenSearch learning path. Example Corp is fictional. Identical for every learner: do not regenerate; verify with verify_corpus.py and ingest as-is.
reproducibility: Neural and hybrid eval numbers additionally depend on the embedding model. The course standard is huggingface/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384 dims). Same corpus + same model = same numbers as the videos.
